signalLineageRule: Reconstruct active qualified B3 rows at knowledgeBoundaryAt with the same lifecycle, economicEventAt and companyEconomicKey dedup semantics as B3 v1. Exact buyDollars and saleDollars must match the frozen event or the gate fails.
tickerEvidenceRule: Collect issuer.ticker only from PIT reconciled rows active in the frozen 30-day B3 state at knowledgeBoundaryAt. Do not use current/future ticker maps.
eligibilityRule: Exactly one non-placeholder PIT ticker must be supported by the active state.
collisionRule: If the same ticker and evaluationSession are attached to more than one issuer CIK, all affected events are explicit identity attrition.
